lines.say: Five facts about octopuses that sound made up, but are completely true.
lines.caption: 5 octopus facts
lines.cap: Five facts about octopuses that sound made up, but are completely true.

lines.say: One. An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills, and one pumps it around the body.
lines.caption: Three hearts
lines.cap: One. An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills, and one pumps it around the body.

lines.say: Two. Its blood is blue, thanks to a copper-based protein called hemocyanin.
lines.caption: Blue blood
lines.cap: Two. Its blood is blue, thanks to a copper-based protein called hemocyanin.

lines.say: Three. About two thirds of its neurons are in its arms, so each arm can feel and taste on its own.
lines.caption: Smart arms
lines.cap: Three. About two thirds of its neurons are in its arms, so each arm can feel and taste on its own.

lines.say: Four. It has no bones, so it can squeeze through any gap bigger than its hard beak.
lines.caption: No bones
lines.cap: Four. It has no bones, so it can squeeze through any gap bigger than its hard beak.

lines.say: Five. It can change its color and even its skin texture in an instant, and vanish into the reef.
lines.caption: Camouflage
lines.cap: Five. It can change its color and even its skin texture in an instant, and vanish into the reef.
